reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis incorrectly relies on a chromium oxide layer for protection, but chromium oxide is chemically unstable in molten aluminum and will be rapidly reduced, making the proposed mechanism unsound.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and feasible, with a well-defined falsification criterion based on comparing corrosion rates of coated vs. uncoated components.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it proposes a fundamentally flawed mechanism (chromium oxide protection) that is known to fail in molten aluminum environments.
